title: Inspect native Windows before setup writes and explain the WSL-blocked path.
verification: Fake-facts tests cover preflight refusals and notices on every OS. The Microsoft Visual C++ runtime check (vcruntime140.dll, vcruntime140_1.dll, msvcp140.dll) passes when System32 or the engine bin holds them or Microsoft's pinned redistributable is reachable; Yoke then installs them app-local in the engine bin with no elevation after each engine fetch and before each local start. With no source it refuses local setup at the gate and again at Review, however local was chosen. A failed local start names the failing tool and its exit status, and names server.log only when it exists. Native runtime acceptance remains pending; no support claim follows from these verdicts.
